The '''Taqual racing pit''' was a [[racetrack]] located on the [[planet]] [[Utapau]], situated inside a minor [[sinkhole]] that once housed a [[city]]. The racing pit was used for the [[Duo Relay Race]], featuring teams of [[dactillion]] and [[varactyl]] riders.<ref name="COTR" />
